task_description: Implement multi-user layer for 9Router: user registration/login, per-user API key management, usage tracking per user, quota enforcement, minimal UI portal, and Playwright e2e tests. All gated behind MULTI_USER_MODE=true env var to maintain backward compatibility.

verification.summary: npm run build passes cleanly. All 36 Playwright e2e tests pass (registration, login, keys, usage, quota, admin, UI flows). Existing vitest suite unchanged (573 pass, 24 pre-existing failures unrelated to changes). Tests exercise real API endpoints and UI flows with meaningful assertions that would fail if code were reverted.
